mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equities, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, increasing recession risk and prompting equity investors to demand higher risk premiums, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 6.5%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and triggering negative forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.5 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, signaling a weakening economy and reducing corporate profitability, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100.5, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the CPIAUCSL above 233.5 over a 2-month window signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to delay rate cuts or initiate tightening, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 233.5, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% and a decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) below 136,000 signals a labor market breakdown, increasing recession risk and triggering a flight to safety, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both UNRATE > 6.5% and PAYEMS < 136000, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 430,000 million dollars combined with a rise in housing starts (HOUST) above 1,090,000 units signals strong aggregate demand, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in less than 40% of instances when both RSAFS > 430000 and HOUST > 1090, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 101.0 combined with a drop in GDP (GDPC1) below 15,800 billion dollars signals a contraction in real economic output, reducing corporate profitability and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both INDPRO < 101.0 and GDPC1 < 15800, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
